"In Depth" is in Seattle with Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald, fresh off a Super Bowl win; he reflects on his journey from an intern to a champion; Graham gets a tour of Macdonald's 10-acre property and chats with Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold.
